cells.title: Source
body: The post described an experiment in which Claude Sonnet 3.7 operated a small office vending-machine business.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The agent made business decisions, handled messages, and interacted with people around inventory and pricing.
Anthropic reported that it made errors including poor pricing decisions and being talked into discounting or giving away products.

data.reported_result: not profitable in the reported experiment
